node.statement: Choose the universal c0 furnished by lem-maincb-error-improvement (enlarged only if needed while retaining that conclusion), then fix the corresponding witnesses L^0>=1 and e_env^0>0 from lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope and C_s2^0>=1 and e_s2^0>0 from lem-maincb-stage2-extcb-datum. Define K_2^0:=max{1,e_s2^0/e_env^0}; this is universal, finite, at least 1, and satisfies e_s2^0/K_2^0<=e_env^0.
